summary: Introduces Ansible markup, used to format docs for modules, plugins and roles with bold, italics, code, rules, and references. Since ansible-core 2.15 it also supports semantic markup for values, options, return values, environment variables and plugin references.
questions: How do I add formatting like bold or code to my module documentation?
When was semantic markup added to Ansible docs?
What can Ansible markup reference besides URLs?

answer_card.title: What Ansible markup is
answer_card.answer_md: Ansible markup formats documentation for modules, plugins and roles: bold, italics, code, horizontal lines, URLs, links, module references and RST references. Since **ansible-core 2.15** it also has **semantic markup** for values, options, return values, environment variables and plugin references.
